about: CPUID (family-model-stepping, as a microcode update's header and its file name write it) to the processors sold with it. An X in a CPUID stands for any one hexadecimal digit. The list is the source's and is not complete; a CPUID can appear in more than one entry. An entry with source "extra" is not the article's: it is from Skills/update-cpuid-brand-names/scripts/extra-entries.json, which gives each fact's page. sSpec lists the article's codes and those added from sSpecSources; sSpecSource says, for each added code, which.

ark.about: Intel ARK, the Ordering & Compliance tab of each model's page; the URL per model is in Skills/update-cpuid-brand-names/scripts/ark-sspec.json
